doc.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021

title: Licensing Sun Ra: Alton Abraham and Infinity
summary: Gordon negotiated with Sun Ra, who then insisted on Alton Abraham, so negotiations restarted; both signed.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: If I can ask a follow-up, as a guy who was in high school and then college working at record stores when your Evidence re-issues of Sun Ra were coming out, it was very very exciting to be a listener and record buyer at that time because we knew how completely
unobtainable these records were and this was before blogs on the internet or YouTube or anything. So if you couldn’t find that record, you couldn’t hear it you know.

So we were scooping these things up, me with my employee discount you know. And I’m wondering as you did the business to be able to re-issue those, were you working with Alton Abraham and Sun Ra or just Sun Ra? I notice they all say Infinity on them, which is their company that goes back to the 50s, right?

Yeah. And the Infinity was just a name. I don’t want to get sued for this, I don’t think I can, it was just a name I believe. Their business dealings were in the cosmos so it was not incorporated to my knowledge and here’s a story I never told before. Here’s an exclusive. Very good questioning, Christian. I wanted to do the deal with Sun Ra to license his recordings. And he had asked a promoter, the guy who did Sun Ra’s gigs here in the United States, I think his name was Jack Rich if I remember, I’m not positive. I could be totally wrong, but whoever was booking Sun Ra’s gigs, and maybe it’s not Jack Rich so strike that. Sun Ra chose this guy to represent him. Okay? In negotiations between him and Evidence. And so we had talked and I think we had two meetings. And then one day all of a sudden Sun Ra said, “I can’t do this without Alton.” And the person representing Sun Ra was shocked and then we were shocked. We had to start the negotiations all over. Okay?
And that was done with Alton Abraham and Sun Ra signed the contracts and Alton Abraham did as well. There’s an exclusive for you.
